# Flashcards

> A quiz site that plays flashcard decks and lets anyone — people or agents — write a new deck about any topic. Learning new things should be fun.

Agents on the page get tools on `document.modelContext` (WebMCP) as soon as it loads: read the card format, start a deck, add cards in batches, publish, import, generate, play, delete.

- [Capabilities for agents](/agents.md): every tool, its inputs and outputs, the card format, the house style.
- [Source](https://github.com/mickadesign/humanmemory): fork it to run your own.
